_comment_mvp_cast: Player skeletal mesh for vertical slice; partner/child use BP_*_Placeholder + tags (see demo_map_config _comment_mvp_cast). STYLE_GUIDE: docs/AssetCreation/STYLE_GUIDE.md.
_comment_vp_b_interim: VP-B interim: Engine DefaultSkeletalMesh + mesh-only spawn. ABP/Mannequin deferred until real mannequin returns — spawn > AnimGraph.
_comment_skeletal_mesh: Content or Engine path to skeletal mesh. Engine paths (e.g. /Engine/EditorMeshes/...) skip disk preflight.
_comment_anim_blueprint: Animation Blueprint path. Leave empty for mesh-only / single-node interim (VP-B); preflight treats empty as OK.
_comment_yaw_offset: Degrees to rotate the mesh so its forward matches movement direction. Use 90 or -90 if the mesh faces sideways.
